Macrons

Consonantal i

Theme

Tools, fasteners & household repair

hew verb

also dress timber, chip into shape

classical

Cato, Agr. 14: dolābit, secābit, of the contractor’s timber work
Cic. Div. 2.86 (Lewis & Short)

dolō, dolāre, dolāvī, dolātum

verb, first conjugation

hew, chip into shape with an axe or adze

Examples

  • Faber tignum asciā dolat.

    The carpenter is dressing the beam with the adze.composed

  • quī trabem asciā dolābat

    who was dressing a beam with the adzeLibellus VII, Diēs ūnus Osoitsae

See also adze.

SourcesLewis & Short: dolo

Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026, with their glosses. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word; classical passages are cited by author.

The example sentence marked “composed” is ours.
